gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 identifies the same defect in the bifurcation-order lemma: the proof establishes only the undivided balance identity, while the displayed derivative formula divides by I(p) without assuming I(p) is nonzero. It explicitly recognizes admissible I(p)=0 points where the formula becomes 0/0 and supplies the corresponding repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The lemma asserts a quotient formula for kappa_p' on a domain that permits I(p)=0, although only the product balance identity is universally established; at such points the quotient is undefined and must be conditional on I(p) != 0.

component_coverage.gold_component: The displayed quotient for the derivative is not valid on the full stated domain because I(p) may vanish, producing an undefined 0/0 expression; the universally valid statement is the undivided balance identity, with the quotient requiring I(p) != 0.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction directly states that the proof yields the undivided identity, that the hypotheses do not exclude I(p)=0, that the numerator also vanishes there so the quotient is 0/0, and that the repair is to add I(p) != 0 or avoid division.
